capability.purpose: Run one command that uploads local HWPX candidates when present, starts the server candidate scanner in background mode, and returns the server scan summary.

validationCommands.evidence: Pipeline returned PASS, uploadVerdict NO_LOCAL_CANDIDATE_DIR, uploaded 0, serverScan.reportVerdict PASS, serverScan.finalStatus CANDIDATE_SCAN_PASS_REVIEW_REQUIRED, promotionRequiresApproval true.

claimBoundary: Basic HWPX read is verified; full compatibility and UI fidelity remain open.
holdItems: Pipeline success does not promote candidate files into the checked-in corpus.
Candidate promotion remains a separate explicit approval step.
